baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three-part construction joins the later/other horizon, beneficial goodness, and persistence without collapsing them into one property.
baseline_models.mechanism: Laterness supplies the compared horizon, goodness supplies the reason for preference, and persistence supplies resistance to loss. Keeping the last two predicates distinct prevents mere longevity from counting automatically as good.

activation_trace.role: The later-or-other-than-first branch establishes the relational horizon being compared.
The desired and beneficial good branch supplies qualitative superiority, not just temporal succession.
The persistence-against-perishing branch supplies the durability dimension of the comparison.

changed_reading.before: The latter is simply better and lasts longer.
changed_reading.after: The latter horizon is preferred because its benefit and its resistance to extinction coincide, while remaining analytically distinct.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus roots themselves permit a deferred-time branch, a better-option branch, and a held-reserve branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can stage an allocation decision: value not exhausted in the first horizon is deferred, selected as the better option, and conserved as reserve. Delay is therefore not emptiness but protected capacity.

activation_trace.role: The deferral-to-a-later-time branch supplies postponed realization rather than simple absence.
The choosing-the-better-option branch turns the comparison into a decision between alternatives.
The held-back reserve branch makes durability function as conserved, unspent capacity.

changed_reading.before: The verse only reports fixed attributes of two worlds.
changed_reading.after: The verse can also stage a choice between immediate expenditure and a better deferred reserve.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The branch inventory of the focus permits beneficent giving beside sparing and keeping alive.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside passive endurance, the final predicate can echo an agentive relation: the latter order gives more good by sparing, preserving, or refusing total loss. This remains a secondary activation rather than a replacement gloss.

activation_trace.role: The latter-or-other branch locates the proposed preserving order beyond the first one.
The beneficence-and-gift branch renders goodness as something given to a recipient.
The sparing-and-keeping-alive branch supplies active preservation instead of duration alone.

changed_reading.before: More lasting describes only the duration of the latter realm.
changed_reading.after: As a live secondary reading, the latter realm may also be more preserving: its goodness consists partly in what it spares from loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pasture-to-debris sequence provides a negative test for the baseline: a thing can be later and can remain as residue without being better. The separate predicate of goodness therefore filters persistence, distinguishing valuable survival from waste left by transformation.

activation_trace.role: The beneficial-good branch becomes the quality filter that mere sequence and residue lack.
The remaining-portion branch supplies residue as a neutral category whose value must still be tested.
The pasture branch supplies a living and useful initial state for the context's material transformation.
The making-something-into-a-state branch supplies the transition arrow from pasture to its later condition.
The pasture-become-dry-debris branch supplies a later remainder that is durable enough to remain but not desirable.

structural_cues: The consecutive 87:4-5 sequence moves from emerged pasture to transformed debris before 87:17 evaluates another later state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies useful growth followed by a degraded later residue; I infer that this sequence tests and revises any equation of laterness with goodness. A live alternative is that 87:4-5 only displays creative power and does not qualify the comparison in 87:17.

changed_reading.before: Being later and remaining longer are enough to establish superiority.
changed_reading.after: The latter is superior as good persistence, not mere persistence: the surah has already shown that some later residues are worthless.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation, threatened forgetting, renewed recollection, and benefit form a retention circuit. This activates a cognitive and transmissive mode of persistence: a good remains not merely by existing somewhere, but by staying recoverable and effective for a hearer.

activation_trace.role: The beneficial-good branch makes retained content count as good when it continues to produce benefit.
The remaining-effect branch supplies persistence as an accessible remainder rather than bare elapsed duration.
The reading-and-recitation branch supplies the repeated act that keeps content available.
The loss-from-memory branch supplies the failure mode against which persistence is measured.
The restoring-to-mind branch supplies recovery after possible forgetting and closes the retention circuit.
The benefit-against-harm branch makes efficacy, not storage alone, the criterion of successful retention.

structural_cues: 87:6 and 87:9 place non-forgetting and renewed reminder around a repeated verbal delivery.
The conditional benefit clause leaves open that retained words must still become effective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a recitation-memory-reminder-benefit chain; I infer that recoverability is one mode of remaining and that efficacy is one mode of goodness. The alternative is that these verses concern prophetic instruction only, while 87:17 remains exclusively ontological.

changed_reading.before: More lasting denotes only how long the latter realm exists.
changed_reading.after: It can also describe good that remains retrievable and beneficial through recitation, memory, and renewed reminder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The manifest-hidden pair places reality on an accessibility axis as well as a time axis. The latter or other horizon can therefore be presently absent from view yet fully within knowledge; its concealment need not weaken its comparative reality or persistence.

activation_trace.role: The later-or-other branch permits the compared horizon to be relationally absent rather than only chronologically future.
The persistence branch lets the concealed horizon remain real despite lacking present visibility.
The disclosure-to-a-knower branch supplies epistemic access that does not depend on public visibility.
The visibly manifest branch supplies one pole of the context's accessibility contrast.
The concealment branch supplies the other pole and activates an unseen register for the latter horizon.

structural_cues: The coordinated antithesis of the manifest and what is hidden in 87:7 places both under one knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a known pair of manifest and concealed realities; I infer that the latter can occupy the currently concealed side without being unreal. The live alternative is that the pair only describes exhaustive knowledge and leaves آخِرَة purely temporal.

changed_reading.before: The latter is only a point farther along a timeline.
changed_reading.after: The latter may also be the presently concealed other register: absent to sight, present to knowledge, and no less enduring.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fiery state in which one neither dies nor lives is a negative control for endurance. It can continue without qualifying as beneficial life, so the focus's two predicates must work together: what is more lasting is preferable only as a mode of living good, not as endless continuation by itself.

activation_trace.role: The beneficial-good branch excludes painful continuation from the kind of endurance praised by the focus.
The persistence branch supplies duration, which the context then shows can be either good or dreadful.
The encountering-fire-and-heat branch supplies the harmful environment of the counterexample.
The kindled-fire branch makes the continuing condition materially active rather than neutral duration.
The loss-of-life branch supplies one denied exit from the continuing state.
The life-as-benefit-and-good branch makes the denial of life a denial of qualitative flourishing, not merely biological status.

structural_cues: The balanced negations in 87:13 suspend the subject between death and life after the fire clause of 87:12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire followed by neither dying nor living, plus a branch equating life with benefit; I infer a harmful persistence that qualifies the semantics of أبقى. The alternative is that this is only a contrast between destinations and does not internally analyze the focus predicates.

changed_reading.before: Longer duration is intrinsically the better condition.
changed_reading.after: The praised endurance is enduring beneficial life; the passage explicitly permits a terrible continuation that is neither death nor genuine life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Preference for the near life exposes a salience bias: proximity is being mistaken for value. The focus answers with a three-step correction, moving from the near object of choice to the deferred alternative, then naming it the better option and the conserved reserve.

activation_trace.role: The deferred-time branch supplies the option discounted because it is not immediately available.
The choosing-the-better branch turns the focus into a corrective decision rule.
The reserve branch supplies value conserved beyond immediate use.
The life-as-benefit branch supplies the genuinely attractive good whose near form competes for preference.
The preference-by-choice branch supplies the human selection that the focus immediately reevaluates.
The nearness branch identifies proximity, rather than badness in life itself, as the feature distorting selection.

structural_cues: The adversative opening of 87:16 and the immediate الدنيا/الآخرة contrast make 87:17 a reply to an enacted preference.
The two comparative predicates answer one choice with both quality and durability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies choice, beneficial life, nearness, deferral, and reserve; I infer that proximity drives temporal discounting and that 87:17 reverses it. The alternative is a direct moral hierarchy without a general account of how nearness biases valuation.

changed_reading.before: The focus offers detached information about the hereafter.
changed_reading.after: The focus is an intervention in choice: do not equate the nearest benefit with the best one when the deferred good preserves more value.

context_deltas.mechanism: The claim that privileges the latter is located in the first written records. First and latter therefore form a transmission loop rather than a simple replacement: an early inscription carries an outcome-oriented judgment through successive records, making the later-directed teaching itself a surviving remainder.

activation_trace.role: The later-than-first branch supplies the horizon praised by a teaching already present at the opposite temporal pole.
The surviving-remainder branch supplies the teaching's persistence across records and receptions.
The written-sheet branch supplies an archival medium in which the later-directed judgment precedes its present recitation.
The repeated written-sheet branch extends the archival claim across separately named prior records.
The beginning-and-precedence branch supplies the first pole that unexpectedly carries praise of the latter.
The return-to-outcome branch folds beginning toward final consequence and makes the temporal poles mutually legible.
The non-dominant succession branch supplies record-after-record continuity without collapsing the packet's split mapping.

structural_cues: The deictic هذا in 87:18 points backward and places the preceding teaching in the first sheets.
The repetition of sheets in 87:18-19 converts archival presence into an explicit chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a backward deictic, first written records, an outcome branch, and a non-dominant succession branch; I infer that transmission is one mechanism of the teaching's persistence. The live alternative is that هذا points to the whole admonition rather than specifically to 87:17.

changed_reading.before: The latter is a newer reality that simply supersedes what came first.
changed_reading.after: The judgment favoring the latter is itself ancient and repeatedly transmitted: laterness concerns the valued horizon, not novelty of the teaching.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines physical posterior, selected excellence, and residue branches into a material process image rather than a primary lexical gloss. It remains anchored in all three focus words and is sharpened by the packet's worthless-debris foil; downstream prose should present it only as an end-product analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The physical rear branch of the first focus word, the chosen-excellence branch of the second, and the remainder branch of the third can describe what is found at the back end of a process.

activation_trace.role: The physical-rear branch turns the latter horizon into the back end of a material process.
The chosen-excellence branch marks one terminal product as selected rather than incidental.
The residue branch supplies what is left after the process has run.
The negligible-debris branch supplies the rejected end-product against which a choice remainder is distinguished.

changed_reading.before: The hereafter is only a later location.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the rear of a process reveals its remainder, and goodness distinguishes the choice residue from discard.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The agentive force is form-distant from the ordinary comparative reading of the final focus word, so it should not replace more enduring. It remains worth carrying because the packet explicitly supplies sparing, beneficence, nurturing completion, and covenant-preservation branches; downstream prose should label it a causative echo.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's sparing branch allows the final predicate to describe what the latter order does for life, not only how long that order lasts.

activation_trace.role: The beneficence-and-gift branch makes the latter good relationally generous.
The sparing-and-keeping-alive branch supplies the exploratory agentive force of preserving another.
The nurturing, repairing, and completing branch supplies an agent who maintains value toward completion.
The preserving-and-covenant-care branch gives active maintenance a social and fiduciary shape.

changed_reading.before: The latter only outlasts the nearer life.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary causative echo, the latter may also preserve better: its beneficence repairs, spares, and keeps faith with what would otherwise be lost.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the strangest retained activation because the specialized coaxing-from-a-burrow branch is remote from the ordinary sense of good. It remains packet-anchored through the focus's better-option and reserve network plus the context's exit and near-choice branches; downstream prose should render it only as a spatial analogy of redirected desire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A rare focus branch pictures one opening being obstructed so an animal exits another, while the other focus branches supply deferral and reserve.

activation_trace.role: The deferral branch supplies the other opening as a later route rather than a vanished good.
The coaxing-out-through-another-opening branch supplies the unusual redirection mechanism.
The held-reserve branch makes what is denied immediate release remain available through the alternate route.
The movement-to-an-exterior branch supplies the actual exit phase of the spatial analogy.
The preference branch supplies desire moving toward one opening rather than another.
The nearness branch identifies the immediately available opening that captures preference.

changed_reading.before: Deferring the near good means simply refusing it.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial analogy, blocking the nearest outlet can reroute desire toward a later opening where value exits without exhausting the reserve.

strongest_changes: The pasture-debris cycle and the neither-death-nor-life state make mere lateness or duration insufficient; goodness qualifies which persistence deserves preference.
Recitation, memory, reminder, and written sheets activate retrievability and transmission as modes of remaining alongside ontological endurance.
The immediate preference for near life turns 87:17 from detached description into a corrective decision rule about proximity, deferred value, and reserve.
The first sheets carry praise of the latter, allowing first and later to coexist as poles in one durable transmission chain.
summary.what_was_special: The packet supported several coexisting readings without forcing a final choice: temporal endurance, qualitative flourishing, hidden reality, mnemonic availability, archival survival, and an exploratory agentive preserving. Its remote branches also yielded contained material analogies of terminal residue and rerouted exit that a conservative audit would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the final predicate can sustain an agentive echo of more preserving or should remain strictly comparative and intransitive.
Whether the hidden-manifest axis changes the semantics of the latter horizon or only supplies an epistemic analogy.
Whether the backward deictic in 87:18 points narrowly to 87:17 or to the broader preceding admonition.
How much interpretive weight the physical-rear, burrow-exit, and non-dominant succession branches can bear beyond exploratory analogy.
